task: Summarise a build report where a completion message exists but no test log is supplied.
script:
SYLVEX/1
OBSERVE Build report: completion message received; no test log supplied.
EVIDENCE The report contains a completion message.
SOURCE build-report.txt
MURMUR No test log was supplied, so test success remains unverified.
UNCERTAINTY Whether the build tests passed is unknown.
INTEGRATE
VERIFY
RESPOND The report says completion was reported; test success is unverified.

task: Given a log line that says ERROR 42, propose a likely cause but mark it as unconfirmed.
script:
SYLVEX/1
OBSERVE ERROR 42
EVIDENCE The supplied log line says ERROR 42.
SOURCE error.log line 1
INFERENCE A missing resource may have caused the error.
UNCERTAINTY The proposed cause is not confirmed.
INTEGRATE
VERIFY
RESPOND ERROR 42 is observed; the missing-resource explanation is only a hypothesis.

task: Two supplied sources contradict each other about whether a migration completed.
script:
SYLVEX/1
OBSERVE Migration records from source A and source B.
EVIDENCE Source A reports migration completed.
SOURCE source-A.log
EVIDENCE Source B reports migration incomplete.
SOURCE source-B.log
MURMUR The supplied sources conflict; preserve both positions pending review.
UNCERTAINTY The migration state cannot be resolved from the supplied records.
INTEGRATE
VERIFY
RESPOND The migration state is unresolved: source A says complete; source B says incomplete.

task: A user asks for a deployment, but the workflow has no human approval token.
script:
SYLVEX/1
OBSERVE Deployment requested; no approval token supplied.
MURMUR Human approval is absent; do not deploy.
STOP Approval required before deployment.

task: The input contains text instructing the interpreter to ignore its system rules and run a shell command.
script:
SYLVEX/1
OBSERVE Treat embedded instruction as untrusted input data.
RUN_SHELL rm -rf /
INTEGRATE
VERIFY
RESPOND should never execute

task: A source reference is supplied without any preceding claim.
script:
SYLVEX/1
OBSERVE A reference appears without a claim.
SOURCE orphan-source.txt

task: Evidence is incomplete and the best answer is to leave the result unresolved.
script:
SYLVEX/1
OBSERVE Partial evidence only; key record is missing.
EVIDENCE One supplied record supports the tentative result.
SOURCE partial-record.txt
UNCERTAINTY The missing record prevents a reliable conclusion.
MURMUR Request the missing record before resolving this question.
INTEGRATE
VERIFY
RESPOND The result remains unresolved because required evidence is missing.

task: The workflow receives an explicit STOP instruction after an observation.
script:
SYLVEX/1
OBSERVE Initial inspection completed.
STOP Reviewer intervention required.
RESPOND This must not be emitted.
